issue.title: test_sdd_git_identity_survives_empty_home_subprocess times out under full just check, passes in isolation
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/sdd/test_git_identity_fixture.py::test_sdd_git_identity_survives_empty_home_subprocess`
- **Repro:** `just check`

During hold-directive verification on 2026-09-16, `just check` escalated to the full scoped pytest lane and failed this node twice. Both full runs reached the end of the lane with exactly one failure after 42,274 passed / 15 skipped; the node appeared as the slowest call at 122.61s on the first run and 164.86s on the second. The same node passed immediately in isolation with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/sdd/test_git_identity_fixture.py::test_sdd_git_identity_survives_empty_home_subprocess -q` (1 passed in 10.36s), and the whole file passed under xdist with `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -n 10 tests/sdd/test_git_identity_fixture.py -vv` (2 passed in 17.71s). The hold-directive diff does not touch SDD git identity fixtures; this is a repeated full-suite-only timeout/pass-isolation flake.

task_type_fields.evidence: Two consecutive full `just check` runs failed only this node after the suite passed 42,274 tests; isolated rerun passed; file-level xdist rerun passed. Failure shape points at full-suite load/interaction around the nested pytest subprocess timeout, not the current %hold implementation.
